item.text: The modules are intentionally small. The report currently bypasses `effectivePayments`, so rejected payments are counted. Checkout stores split parts under separate keys, while whole checkout only checks the whole-payment key; that allows a retry to double-book a line after a split. I’m aligning both consumers with the payment module’s booking records.
